author: y. e. campbell
title: Florida Gulf Coast men's golf finishes fifth at SeaBest Invitational - Lee Today
text:
The Florida Gulf Coast University men’s golf team finished in fifth place at the SeaBest Invitational, which concluded Tuesday at Atlantic Beach Country Club in Florida. The Eagles stood out in the tournament by recording 36 birdies, the highest total among all teams competing.
Sebastian Gamboa led FGCU with an even-par finish, shooting a 69 in his final round. Sacha Ruiz followed closely, posting a final-round 73 to end the week at 1-over par and tying for the 12th-most birdies in the field with eight across two rounds.
Brett Moore completed his tournament at 2-over par after a final-round 72, while Christian Figueredo also finished at 2-over par following a 73. Nolan Harper closed with a score of 74, finishing 3-over par and tying for the tenth-most birdies in the field with nine.
Sam Baker participated as an individual and finished with a score of 7-over par after a final-round 77.
Head Coach Andrew Danna commented on the team’s performance: “I’m really proud of our team. They did a good job this week getting our spring season started. We are looking forward to our next opportunity to compete.”
FGCU will continue its spring season at the Gators Invitational scheduled for February 14-15 at Mark Bostick Golf Club in Gainesville, hosted by the University of Florida.
To follow updates on FGCU men’s golf, fans can visit their Instagram and X accounts at FGCU_MGolf.
